title: mimi-mls: keep signing keys inside the crate
description: From .4.2: mimi_mls::label::sign_with_label and decrypt_with_label take raw private-key byte slices, so signing/HPKE private keys cross the crate boundary. Add Identity-held methods (e.g. Identity::sign_with_label) so callers never handle key bytes, and narrow the raw-key functions to pub(crate) or document them as test/hub-only. Also: make identity.rs's suite-1 CIPHERSUITE constant pub(crate) and delete label.rs's duplicate.
